title: DNS Spoofing Detection
story: The network is under DNS spoofing attack. Students investigate DNS responses and identify manipulated traffic.

tasks.title: Capture DNS Traffic
tasks.description: Collect DNS queries and responses from the affected network.
tasks.hint: Filter for UDP or TCP port 53.

tasks.title: Compare Legitimate Responses
tasks.description: Compare DNS answers with a trusted resolver.
tasks.hint: Use dig against multiple DNS servers.

tasks.title: Detect Spoofed Packets
tasks.description: Identify mismatched or forged DNS responses.
tasks.hint: Look for duplicate transaction IDs or unexpected answer IPs.

tasks.title: Block Attacker
tasks.description: Block the source responsible for DNS manipulation.
tasks.hint: Apply a firewall rule against the attacker IP.
